title: I ported 0 A.D to Android using Sol 6.1 entirely on my phone
author: TofuMeltatSunspot
selftext: 0 A.D is a free 100% open source RTS game developed by WildFire Games similar to Age of Empires. I thought it would be a good challenge for 6.1 Sol to see if it could build a playable port and im surpised to say it worked pretty well. I used the codex remote feature in the chatgpt app on my phone and after a few failed apks it built something playable. Its crazy to me to that something that would have taken an experienced game dev weeks five years ago can be done on your phone by an idiot with no tech skills (me) in an afternoon.
